ChatLLM – The Most Powerful AI Assistant on Mobile
Chat, Create, Listen & Automate with State-of-the-Art AI

ChatLLM brings together the world's best AI models — GPT-5, o4, Opus 4.8, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more — into one app. Chat naturally, generate images and videos, transcribe meetings live, or let the AI Agent autonomously handle complex tasks for you.


AGENT — AUTONOMOUS AI AGENT
Give the Agent a task and watch it work. It uses multiple AI models, browses the web, writes code, and connects to your tools to complete complex multi-step tasks autonomously.
• Research, analyze, and compile reports
• Build and deploy websites and apps
• Connect to Gmail, Google Drive, Jira, Slack, and more
• Track progress with real-time task updates

AI LISTENER — REAL-TIME MEETING INTELLIGENCE
Record any conversation and get live AI-powered transcription and insights.
• Real-time transcription in 100+ languages
• AI-generated suggestions while you listen
• Automatic session summaries
• Custom analysis templates (Key Points, Technical Analysis, or your own)
• Chat with AI about any past session
• Background recording — switch apps without losing audio

ADVANCED AI CHAT
Natural, human-like conversations powered by 15+ language models. Ask questions, brainstorm, debug code, or tackle any topic.

VOICE CHAT
Full voice conversations with AI. Choose from multiple voices, switch between automatic and manual recording modes, and go hands-free.

IMAGE & VIDEO GENERATION
Turn text into visuals with Nano Banana, Flux Pro Ultra, DALL-E, Imagen, Ideogram, Recraft, and more. Generate videos with VEO 3, Runway, Kling AI, and Minimax.

DEEP RESEARCH
AI-powered web research with source citations. Get comprehensive, multi-source answers to complex questions with real-time activity tracking.

CODE EXECUTION
Run code directly in chat. Debug, generate snippets, and test ideas with a built-in terminal and playground.

DOCUMENT ANALYSIS
Upload files for instant summaries, Q&A, and analysis. Supports PDFs, images with OCR, and more.

PERSONALIZATION
• Custom instructions for tailored responses
• Memory system that learns your preferences
• Projects to organize conversations and files
• Thinking mode for complex reasoning


15+ AI MODELS IN ONE APP
GPT-5 · o4 · Claude Opus 4.8 · Gemini · DeepSeek · Llama · Grok · Qwen · Perplexity · and more


Why Choose ChatLLM?
• All the best AI models, one subscription
• Multi-modal: Text, Voice, Images, Video, Documents
• AI Agent for autonomous task completion
• AI Listener for meeting intelligence
• SOC-2 and HIPAA compliant — your data stays private

This app requires a subscription. Plans start at $9.99/month.
